_readme: The seven apps on the home page walk, in order. Run python3 _products/walk-gen.py after editing. Each app's name sits on one line (en + ko), so a rename is a one-line change. Facts come only from the repo, the site and the App Store. Anything marked TODO still needs facts from the owners.

line.en: A live Mac screen on your iPad, with touch, keyboard and clipboard going back.
line.ko: Mac 화면을 iPad에 띄우고, 터치와 키보드, 클립보드를 다시 Mac으로 보냅니다.

what.en: A remote desktop app for your tablet. See your computer screen and control it with touch, trackpad and keyboard.
what.ko: 태블릿용 원격 데스크톱 앱이에요. 컴퓨터 화면을 보면서 터치, 트랙패드, 키보드로 조작해요.

for.en: iPad, iPhone and Vision Pro owners with an Apple silicon Mac.
for.ko: Apple 실리콘 Mac과 iPad, iPhone, Vision Pro를 함께 쓰는 사람.

line.en: An iPad app for classroom presentation and annotation.

what.en: An iPad app for classroom presentation and annotation, designed around the materials teachers already use.
what.ko: 선생님이 이미 쓰는 자료를 중심으로 설계한 아이패드 수업·판서 앱입니다.

for.en: teachers who present lessons on an iPad.

en: Work with PPTX, PDF and HTML teaching materials
Support teaching in English and Korean
ko: PPTX, PDF, HTML 수업 자료 사용

line.en: Check paper exams one question at a time.
line.ko: 종이 시험을 문항별로 모아 보며 채점해요.

what.en: A Windows app for checking paper exams one question at a time. You mark each answer right or wrong. The app handles the work around it.
what.ko: 종이 시험을 문항별로 모아 보며 O/X로 체크하는 Windows 앱이에요. 판정은 사람이 하고, 그 앞뒤 일은 프로그램이 맡아요.

en: Make answer sheets and split scans into a box per student and question
Mark one question across the whole class, then move on
Scores, item analysis and report cards
ko: 답안지를 만들고, 스캔본을 학생별·문항별 칸으로 나눠요
한 문항을 반 전체에서 이어서 채점해요

line.en: Five in a row, where every stone has a character.

what.en: A five-in-a-row game on a 15×15 board in 3D. Win with exactly five in a row or ten kills.
what.ko: 15×15 입체 보드에서 두는 오목 게임이에요. 정확히 다섯 줄을 만들거나 열 번 처치하면 이겨요.

en: Eight stone classes, each with its own skill
Seven worlds that change the board
Two players on one device or against the built-in AI, no account
ko: 한 기기에서 둘이, 또는 내장 AI와 대전. 계정 없이
